messages:
Maria (CSM): HarborWave dedicated pool go-live prep — need to finalize quota plan + autoscale policy, run load tests, and capture enablement feedback. Can we sync today? Key params: reserved 5xA100-ish GPUs, expected avg QPS 250, tail 800, 6-week warmup. Also want rollback triggers.

Sam (Infra): I'm available 2pm PT. What does "tail 800" mean — 800 concurrent streams or 800 tok/s? Also do we have a per-customer cap?

Maria (CSM): tail = peak concurrent active sessions during PRD demo (approx 800 concurrent). Per-customer cap needs to be soft at 200c. See contract for quota floors.

Jess (Platform Eng): Ops checklist:
- confirm pool size
- autoscale policy: min=3, target-util=0.7, max=7
- health probes & fallback routing to hosted
Load test script:
```
# run locally
rl-loadtest --env=staging --target=harborwave --qps=300 --concurrency=800 --duration=45m --model=rwi/gpt-4r-8k
```
I'll push a smaller smoke test first.

Tyler (ML Eng): For model variants, suggest priming cache with top-10 prompts and enable prefix KV caching. Also quantized variant for burst fallback.

Maria (CSM): Can we capture enablement feedback from HarborWave PM during warmup? Want a 1-pager onboarding checklist + quick NPS at weeks 2/4.

ops-bot: Scheduled load test job created: job_id=hw-warmup-1928501123, run_at=2026-04-12T21:00:00Z.

Sam (Infra): I pushed autoscale policy to staging: min=3, max=7, scale-step=1, cooldown=90s. Will monitor CPU/GPU utilization dashboards.

Jess (Platform Eng): Running smoke now (45s). Logs: 200/200 initial warmup OK. I'll post link to tracing after full run.

Maria (CSM): perfect :thumbsup: After full run, please capture: latency p50/p95, OOMs, model fallback events, and customer-facing error patterns. Add notes to the run doc.

Sam (Infra): noted. If we hit >85% GPU util for >10m, autoscale should add a node. If scale fails, traffic should route to hosted fallback - already configured.

Jess (Platform Eng): Agree — will also add canary flash rollbacks in the policy.

Maria (CSM): thank you all — I'll send calendar invite 2pm PT and add HarborWave PM.

Tyler (ML Eng): small ask: include a prompt set for quality regression checks post-rollout.

Maria (CSM): added to checklist.

Jess (Platform Eng): OK wrapping — smoke passed, scheduling full load in 20m.

Sam (Infra): I'll watch dashboards.

Maria (CSM): closing for now, will reopen thread with test results. :sparkles:
